title: Part Two: The Name and the Texts (2007–2014)

sections.brief: How the current got its names: formalism (2007), neocameralism, 'reactionary'/'restorationist' and 'neoreactionary' (2008), Land's 'dark enlightenment' (2 March 2012) and the 2014 e-book; who coined what (Land: Dark Enlightenment; Moldbug: the Cathedral); the Yarvin/Land division of labour. Figures: time, compare

Unqualified Reservations 2007-2016; 'A formalist manifesto' (23 Apr 2007), the Open Letter (from 17 Apr 2008), Patchwork (13 and 20 Nov 2008) with the slums and biodiesel passages in context, RAGE (2012); Land's ten-part serial; first readers: Alexander (Oct 2013), Finley (TechCrunch, Nov 2013), Pein (Baffler 2014, 2017; book 2018), Sandifer (2016); worst-case reading tested. Figures: compare, time
